text:
jamie: Heads-up — I'm scheduling a focused profiling window for the quant bench tomorrow 10–11am PT. Goal: collect slice-level latency + loss deltas for int4 vs fp8 on the new longseq prompts. Need a quick ops handoff and one reviewer for the CR that changes the batching heuristic.

sasha: +1. I can take the CR review if it's small. ping me the PR link when it's up. :thumbsup:

jamie: Thanks. PR will be a tiny change in scheduler.py (heuristic tweak + test). I'll post link in a minute. Also posting the exact bench command we'll run so infra can pre-warm nodes:

```
# run on perf pool redwood-quant-stage
run_bench --model redwood-7b-quant --variants int4,fp8 --slices longseq,shortseq --reps 5 --trace-kv --out /tmp/quant-slice-215999
```

omar: Ops note — for longseq with int4 we should bump max_batch_tokens to 8k to avoid excessive micro-batching thrash. I'll add a temporary override on the pool.

lee: Re: quality checks, can you add the small promptset from /doc/quant/longseq-edgecases? Some of those expose degradation (answers get truncated or hallucinate).

jamie: Will do. Early runs did show a small BLEU/EM drop on prompt 12 with int4 vs fp8. Not huge but measurable. We want to capture token-level divergence and the topk token distribution.

rebecca: I can run the eval harness after the bench finishes. If you dump the outputs in the path above I can diff using our usual script. Also add the seed list so runs are reproducible.

jamie: Seed list: [42, 1337, 2024, 31415, 9001] — included in the run config.

bench-bot: CI note — please ensure `bench-smoke` passes pre-run: flake8 OK, unit tests OK, bench image build succeeded last night.

jamie: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serving/+/D3456 — small heuristic change, test added. Sasha, assigning to you.

sasha: Looking now. Quick skim: two nits in docstring and one missing type annotation. Will push a small fix, then approve.

ci-bot: D3456: patch lint passed, unit-tests queued.

omar: Pool override applied (redwood-quant-stage: max_batch_tokens=8192) for 10:30–12:00 PT. I'll monitor GPU utilization.

lee: Quick question — do we want to include a mixed-int8 fallback variant in this run? Could help quantify graceful degradation behavior.

jamie: Good idea. Add variant `int8-fallback` that uses per-layer int8 if int4 scores a large loss increase (simulated). I'll add it to the command. New command will be posted before run.

rebecca: After runs finish I'll produce per-prompt charts: latency vs tokens, delta-BLEU, and topk divergence heatmap. Expect a short report within 2–3 hrs of completion.

jamie: Thanks all. If anything blocks, paste here. Otherwise we'll kick at 10:30 PT and ship the artifacts to /tmp/quant-slice-215999 and `/artifacts/quant/215999/`. :rockon:
